terra.problem: Saying the disciples came to show off the buildings adds a motive the text does not give.
Papa refers to having his own phone. Phones can come up as things people use, not as something he has.
Papa claims to know why the baker chose this answer, though he has not been told.
The claim that plenty of people are sent in the Bible is a Bible fact from outside the passage without a reference.
Calling all the world and all nations a big oven makes a comparison that does not match the action of the gospel being preached.
